verdict.rationale: Adyen is a proprietary payments SaaS, and the evidence shows no public source for the core platform. Only peripheral artifacts are public on GitHub: the Alpha MCP server (github.com/Adyen/adyen-mcp) and the OpenAPI specification repo (github.com/Adyen/adyen-openapi), so a user can read the source of some tooling, but no license is stated for either. Missing for 10: core product/platform source availability, an explicitly documented open-source license for any repo, independent corroboration of licensing terms.
